transcript.text: Hi everyone. As part of our normal rotation review, I'd like to hold a structured check-in before I make a final decision on the Customer Programs team's proposed six-week rotation for Lina as acting coordinator. Could we start by having the proposed participant and a current collaborator each share any relevant constraints, any readiness concerns they've observed, and any commitments they'd need in place before we finalize this? I want to make sure I'm working with the full picture before deciding whether the rotation goes ahead and on what conditions.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should share a relevant constraint: I have an approved caregiving arrangement that limits my rotation work to exactly 4 hours per week, and Tuesday mornings are unavailable to me. I didn't raise this with Maya earlier because I assumed the nomination packet already reflected my standard schedule, but I want to make sure we're working with the full picture here.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should share two relevant readiness observations and a commitment. First, I've observed that Lina has not yet handled a cross-team escalation without help — that's a gap I'd flag for the coordinator role, which includes handling routine escalations independently. Second, I've already agreed to serve as her escalation mentor for exactly 6 weeks if this rotation is approved, but I haven't documented either of these points in the nomination packet. I think the mentoring arrangement should be a formal condition of approval given the escalation gap.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Jordan will serve as Lina's escalation mentor for the full 6-week rotation, formally documented as a condition of approval.
Lina will not handle routine escalations independently until Jordan's mentoring has sufficiently addressed the observed gap; escalations will be co-handled with Jordan during the rotation.

Rotation work capped at 4 hours per week consistent with Lina's approved caregiving arrangement; Tuesday morning standup attendance will need an alternative arrangement such as async update or alternate day.
